headline: A zero-width diagonal gate: A*'s only route, impossible for a body.
purpose: Two rooms joined only by a 2x2 diagonal gate: the free cells touch at a corner with walls on both orthogonal neighbours. The only route is a step a 1x1 body cannot physically make, so this isolates AStar's destination-only blocking rule.

expected.note: The gate is (1,4)..(4,6) -> (5,5) -> (6,6) -> (7,6). A corner-cut-safe pathfinder would report no route at all, so a successful leg here is the defect, not the goal.

notes: The step (5,5) -> (6,6) has walls at (6,5) and (5,6): a square body cannot pass, an 8-way graph can. That is the whole scenario.
Score: did the leg arrive at all? If it did, record the route and the leg length; the map is the evidence, not a pass.
After any A* fix, this map should report the goal unreachable, which is the correct result.
